Since 2014, we have been developing a new generation of nuclear energy technology based on thorium molten salt reactors. Our ambition is to industrialize nuclear energy through mass manufacturing, standardized reactor systems and a fundamentally different approach to deployment and economics. Copenhagen Atomics is approaching 100 employees across Denmark and Switzerland. As we enter the next phase of our growth, we are expanding our investor relations and capital-raising activities from Zug, Switzerland . We are looking for an ambitious Investor Relations Associate who wants to build a career at the intersection of technology, investment and energy . Du vil også bidrage med analyser til Skatte- og Vækstministeriets forhandlinger af dobbeltbeskatningsoverenskomster . Du vil selvstændigt skulle koordinere en række processer med andre ministerier i forbindelse med udarbejdelse af dansk holdning og tilblivelse af nye politiske udspil på bl.a. EU-niveau. Du vil derfor få en bred samarbejdsflade, både internt i ministeriet og i forhold til andre ministerier. Dine opgaver vil bl.a. være: Udformning af dansk holdning til bl.a.
